rows.notes: Two endpoints: /companies/{symbol}/fundamentals?statement_code=balance_sheet_statement&type=FY|QTR (rows under 'fundamentals'), then per fiscal period fan-out via amake_requests to /fundamentals/{symbol}-{code}-{FY}-{p}/standardized_financials (:460-465). Each row is assembled from the response's data_tag.tag keys (alias map :51-140); reported_currency derived from collected 3-letter units (:492); zero values nulled (:395-403); QTR branch remaps fiscal_period FY to Q4 (:495-496). Symbol dashes normalized to dots at :41-45.

Single GET /companies/ipos; rows under initial_public_offerings. Each item carries nested company and security objects (IntrinioCompany/IntrinioSecurity, :149-155). Query aliases symbol->ticker, limit->page_size, min_value->offer_amount_greater_than, max_value->offer_amount_less_than (:25-30); no next-page loop, page_size only caps size.

Same two-endpoint fundamentals pattern as BalanceSheet with statement_code=cash_flow_statement; period branch annual/quarter/ttm/ytd picks the type param and raises for anything else (:262-268). Second URLs are built from fiscal_year-fiscal_period of the first response and fanned out via amake_requests (:284-306); rows keyed by data_tag.tag, zeros nulled, reported_currency derived from units (:308-336).

GET /companies/{symbol}/filings; next_page cursor token in the response is appended as a query param in a while loop (:140-149), rows under 'filings' concatenated, metadata taken from the 'company' key (:138). transform_query sets a 1-year default window only when form_type is absent (:96-100). Rows drop thea_enabled/earnings_release keys (:163-168). Query aliases form_type->report_type, limit->page_size (:28).

GET /companies/{symbol}/news, one task per comma-separated symbol via asyncio.gather (:253-269); inside each symbol a next_page cursor loop concatenates pages under 'news' until the limit (:238-248); cross-symbol url dedupe + sort by publication_date + truncation to limit (:260-265). Rows flattened from body/summary into text (:286-294) and topics array-of-dicts joined to a string (:160-167). Aliases limit->page_size, source->specific_source (:29-32).

Single GET /forex/pairs, rows under 'pairs' via get_data_many sub_dict (:63). Free-text query filtered client-side on code/base_currency/quote_currency substrings with a DataFrame (:76-81); output symbol renamed from upstream code (:26).

Intraday intervals hit /securities/{symbol}/prices/intervals?interval_size= with rows under 'intervals'; daily+ hit /securities/{symbol}/prices?frequency= with rows under 'stock_prices' (:226-231) - branch set by query validator at :83-100. next_page cursor loop extends the same list (:243-250). Rows sorted client-side by 'time' vs 'date' depending on the branch (:266-274). Aliases date->time, change_percent->percent_change, intra_period->intraperiod (:106-111).

GET /companies/{symbol}, one URL per comma-separated symbol fanned out with amake_requests (:63-68); each response is one flat company dict. Output symbol renamed from upstream ticker (:29-31). No pagination or join.

GET /securities/{symbol}/prices/realtime?source=, one URL per comma-separated symbol via amake_requests (:128-133); the callback lifts symbol out of the nested security object and warns on 'messages' (:117-127). exchange/market_center codes mapped through the VENUES dict (references.py:20-40, validator at equity_quote.py:84-90); 10 output names aliased to upstream price fields (:41-52).

Single GET /companies/search, rows under 'companies' (:82, :90). Output renames id->intrinio_id and ticker->symbol (:43-46); query limit aliased to page_size with default 10000 (:26-36); is_symbol excluded from the querystring (:79). No paged loop - one shot.

No dedicated upstream ETF model: provider registers EtfHistorical -> IntrinioEquityHistoricalFetcher (openbb_intrinio/__init__.py:83), so the row's needs are the equity prices behavior read above - intervals/frequency branch (:226-231), next_page cursor concat loop (:243-250), client-side date sort (:266-274).

GET /etfs/{symbol}:US/holdings?page_size=10000, next_page cursor appended and looped until exhausted (:162-185), rows under 'holdings'. Rows sorted client-side by weighting desc (:204); coupon divided by 100 (:207-208); zero values nulled per row (:133-141); deprecated composite_figi popped (:206); 12 output names aliased (:40-53); as_of_date query alias (:30).

GET /etfs/{symbol}, one URL per comma-separated symbol after appending ':US' when no exchange suffix (:621-625) via amake_requests; each response is one flat fund-profile dict (~550-line data model). Results re-sorted client-side back into the caller's requested symbol order (:643-646); per-symbol errors warned away (:629-634).
